articles.title: Saudi Arabia Accelerates $13.3 Billion Indoor Entertainment Center Buildout
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia is intensifying its massive investment in indoor entertainment centers as part of its Vision 2030 diversification strategy. The $13.3 billion program represents one of the largest concentrated FEC development initiatives in history, creating significant opportunities for operators, suppliers, and attraction manufacturers. FEC industry players should monitor this market closely for partnership, licensing, and supply chain opportunities.

articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Posts $1.25B FY2026 Revenue, Narrows EPS Loss
articles.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment Corp, one of the largest bowling and FEC operators in the US, reported $1.25 billion in revenue for fiscal year 2026 with an EPS of negative $0.33 in its annual 10-K filing. The results offer a key financial benchmark for the broader FEC and eatertainment sector. Investors and operators can use these figures to gauge industry-wide performance and capital efficiency trends.

articles.title: Dave & Buster's Strengthens Executive Team to Drive Growth and Innovation
articles.summary: Dave & Buster's has made new additions to its senior leadership team with a focus on operational excellence and innovation. The move signals continued strategic investment in the brand's competitive positioning within the eatertainment space. For FEC operators, the leadership changes at one of the sector's largest players are worth tracking as an indicator of industry priorities.

articles.title: Semnox and Lumos Build Custom RFID Redemption Integration for Multi-Attraction FEC
articles.summary: Texas-based FEC Lumos partnered with Semnox Solutions to develop a bespoke RFID cashless system integrated with Lumos's proprietary redemption platform, going live across its arcade, bowling, axe-throwing, and laser tag attractions in October 2025. The integration reduces friction for guests and staff by unifying play and redemption into a single seamless journey. This case study highlights the growing demand among FEC operators for flexible, customizable technology stacks beyond off-the-shelf solutions.

articles.title: Semnox Parafait RFID Cashless System Powers Texas FEC Lumos Since Launch
articles.summary: Lumos, a Texas entertainment venue featuring arcade, bowling, and other attractions, has relied on the Semnox Parafait RFID cashless system since its October 2025 opening, with custom integrations built for its proprietary redemption platform. The deployment underscores the versatility of modern cashless systems in complex, multi-attraction FEC environments. Operators evaluating technology upgrades can look to this implementation as a real-world model.

articles.title: Skyline Social's 100,000 Sq Ft Minnesota FEC Selects Intercard for Cashless Arcade Management
articles.summary: The newly opened Skyline Social & Games in Apple Valley, Minnesota, a nearly 100,000-square-foot indoor and outdoor FEC operated by the Kolquist family, has chosen Intercard's cashless technology to manage its arcade operations. The venue represents a significant new-build FEC investment in the Midwest, combining gaming with other entertainment offerings. The technology selection reinforces Intercard's continued relevance as a preferred cashless provider for large-format FECs.

articles.title: Slick City Dry Slide Concept Eyes Global Expansion with First European Venue in Nottingham
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park opened a 50,000-square-foot European debut location in Nottingham, UK, in March 2026, featuring 16 high-speed dry slides and the world's first UV AirGlider aerial attraction. With over 40 US locations already operational, the brand founded by a former trampoline park operator is actively pursuing international growth. FEC operators should take note of the dry slide format as an emerging attraction category with proven scalability.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Signs Lease for First Montana Location
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment Centers has signed a lease for its first location in Montana, continuing the trampoline and FEC chain's geographic expansion across the US. The move reflects ongoing demand for large-format family entertainment in underserved markets. Operators and investors tracking FEC franchise growth should note Launch's sustained expansion momentum.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Converts Former Dillard's Anchor Store into Denton, TX Fun Zone
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment is transforming a vacant Dillard's department store in Denton, Texas, into a new FEC venue set to open this fall. The project exemplifies the accelerating trend of repurposing dead retail anchor space for entertainment use. This adaptive reuse strategy continues to be a cost-effective route for FEC expansion in established retail corridors.

articles.title: $50M EVO Entertainment Destination Breaks Ground in Downtown Clearwater
articles.summary: A $50 million EVO Entertainment mixed-use destination is moving forward in downtown Clearwater, Florida, with the site now cleared for construction. EVO Entertainment's model combines cinemas, bowling, arcade games, and dining in a single large-format venue. The scale of investment signals continued operator confidence in the eatertainment destination concept.

articles.title: Texas' Largest Family Entertainment Center Set to Open in Houston in 2026
articles.summary: A new FEC billing itself as the largest in Texas is scheduled to open in the Houston market in 2026, reflecting the continued appetite for supersized family entertainment destinations in major metros. The venue is expected to draw significant regional traffic and set a new benchmark for FEC scale in the state. Houston-area operators and suppliers should monitor this development closely.

articles.title: Slick City Action Park Projects Fall 2026 Opening in Humble, Texas
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park, the fast-growing dry slide FEC concept, is projecting a fall 2026 opening for its Humble, Texas location. The expansion adds to a rapidly growing portfolio of US venues and underscores the brand's aggressive rollout strategy. Operators in the Houston metro should anticipate new competitive pressure from this differentiated indoor attraction format.

articles.title: Minnesota Bowling Centers Reinventing Themselves as Full-Service FECs
articles.summary: A new feature examines how Minnesota's bowling businesses are evolving beyond traditional lanes to incorporate broader entertainment offerings, food and beverage upgrades, and social gaming to attract new demographics. The trend mirrors national shifts as standalone bowling centers face competitive pressure from multi-attraction FECs. Operators considering reinvestment or repositioning will find the strategies highlighted here instructive.

articles.title: Bowling Centers Market Projected to Grow at 4.5% CAGR
articles.summary: A new market research report projects the global bowling centers market will grow at a compound annual growth rate of 4.5%, driven by increased interest in social entertainment and hybrid FEC formats. The data provides a useful benchmark for operators and investors evaluating expansion or acquisition opportunities in the bowling segment. Growth is expected to be fueled by modernization investments and the integration of food, beverage, and other attractions.

articles.title: Valo Motion to Launch 'Groundfall' Interactive Attraction at IAAPA Expo Europe
articles.summary: Valo Motion, a leading developer of interactive projection-based attractions, will debut its new Groundfall product at IAAPA Expo Europe. The launch adds to the company's growing portfolio of active entertainment products popular in FECs and trampoline parks. FEC buyers attending IAAPA Expo Europe should evaluate Groundfall as a potential anchor or secondary attraction.

articles.title: Mr. Gatti's Pizza Seeks Franchisee to Return to Lubbock with New FEC Format
articles.summary: Mr. Gatti's Pizza is actively targeting a return to the Lubbock, Texas market with a new family entertainment center concept built around its pizza restaurant brand. The brand's FEC pivot reflects the broader industry trend of combining dining with gaming and attractions. Prospective franchisees and investors in the Texas market should explore this re-entry opportunity.

articles.title: Mr. Gatti's Franchise Model Eyes New FEC Opportunity in Lubbock
articles.summary: Mr. Gatti's Pizza is actively recruiting a franchisee to open a new family entertainment center in Lubbock, Texas, as part of its broader FEC expansion strategy. The brand aims to blend its established pizza identity with modern arcade and entertainment offerings to compete in the eatertainment market. This opportunity illustrates the continued franchising momentum in the FEC sector for recognized food brands.

articles.title: Bergen County FEC Assets — Trampolines, Bowling, and VR — Head to Auction
articles.summary: A large family entertainment center in Bergen County, New Jersey, is liquidating its assets at auction, including trampolines, bowling lanes, and a virtual reality arena. The auction presents acquisition opportunities for operators looking to equip new venues or expand existing ones at below-market cost. Industry buyers and suppliers should monitor the sale for equipment procurement opportunities.

articles.title: New Family Entertainment Center Opening in Rock Springs, Wyoming
articles.summary: A new family entertainment center is set to open in Rock Springs, Wyoming, bringing FEC amenities to a smaller market. The opening reflects the continued geographic spread of FEC concepts beyond major metro areas. Operators and franchise developers should note the viability of secondary and tertiary market locations for new venue development.

articles.title: Six Flags to Relocate Corporate Headquarters to Texas by 2027
articles.summary: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation announced plans to relocate its corporate headquarters to Texas by 2027, while maintaining an office in Sandusky, Ohio. The move reflects the company's ongoing organizational restructuring following its merger with Cedar Fair. FEC and theme park industry observers should track how this consolidation affects supplier relationships and regional investment priorities.

articles.title: Blue Galaxy Opens Massive Indoor Entertainment Venue in Council Bluffs
articles.summary: Blue Galaxy has opened a large-format indoor entertainment destination in Council Bluffs, Iowa, bringing a new FEC competitor to the Omaha metro market. The venue offers a broad mix of family-friendly attractions designed to capture year-round traffic. Its entry underscores the growing FEC market in secondary Midwest cities.

articles.title: The Back Nine Naperville Brings Indoor Golf and Social Entertainment to Chicago Suburb
articles.summary: The Back Nine Naperville is opening an indoor golf and social entertainment concept in the Chicago suburb this fall, adding to the growing category of golf-adjacent FEC venues. The format, combining golf simulators with food and beverage, continues to attract investment as a proven draw for adult and family audiences. Operators evaluating new attraction categories should consider the strong performance of indoor golf social concepts.

articles.title: Former Jersey Shore Drugstore to Be Converted Into Family Entertainment Center
articles.summary: A long-vacant drugstore in a Jersey Shore location is being repurposed as a family entertainment center, continuing the trend of converting underutilized retail space for entertainment use. The project will introduce FEC amenities to a seasonal tourism market. This conversion highlights how coastal tourist markets are increasingly attractive for FEC development.

articles.title: Struggling Texas FEC Tornado Terry's Turns to GoFundMe as Last Resort
articles.summary: Tornado Terry's Family Amusement Center in the Keller-Roanoke area of northeast Fort Worth has launched a GoFundMe campaign in a last-ditch effort to keep the doors open. The situation spotlights the financial pressures facing small, independent FEC operators competing against larger multi-attraction venues. It serves as a cautionary tale for operators about the importance of diversification, reinvestment, and financial planning.

articles.title: UK Heatwaves Reshape Visitor Patterns at Indoor and Outdoor Attractions
articles.summary: A record-breaking UK summer is having measurable effects on visitor attraction attendance, with outdoor venues facing challenges while indoor and water-based facilities see shifts in demand. The analysis has direct implications for FEC operators in temperate climates who are increasingly seen as weather-resilient alternatives. Operators can use these insights to sharpen their all-weather marketing messaging and capacity planning.

articles.title: WhiteWater Debuts Helix Twist, a New Water Slide Feature That Simulates Rotation
articles.summary: WhiteWater has unveiled Helix Twist, an innovative water slide element that uses changing geometry to create the illusion that the slide is rotating around the rider, delivering a new sensory experience. The product launch adds to WhiteWater's portfolio of differentiated slide experiences relevant to water park and FEC water attraction operators. Buyers planning water attraction upgrades should evaluate this technology for its novelty and guest appeal.

articles.title: New Family Restaurant Entertainment Experience Proposed for Grand Forks Venue
articles.summary: A proposal for a family-focused restaurant and entertainment experience at the Franklin on Fourth location in Grand Forks has received preliminary city council approval for a tax incentive. The concept reflects the eatertainment model gaining traction in smaller US cities. FEC operators and restaurant brands exploring hybrid concepts in secondary markets may find this development instructive.
